title: Vitamin K antagonists: monitoring and dose safety
intro: Vitamin K antagonists such as warfarin reduce clotting and help prevent dangerous clots. Too little effect may leave clot risk; too much increases bleeding. Safe treatment depends on an individual INR target and a clear dosing plan.

sections.heading: Understanding the problem
paragraphs: An INR blood test measures the medicine’s effect. The target and testing interval depend on the reason for treatment and stability; there is no universal safe dose or target for every patient. Different tablet strengths must be checked carefully.

sections.heading: Assessment and tests
paragraphs: Keep an accurate dose and test record, and know who gives the next instruction. Home INR testing or self-adjustment is suitable only after structured training and agreement with the treating service, not by copying an online table. Bring your medicine list and previous results; ask which findings would change the plan.

sections.heading: Treatment choices
paragraphs: Illness, vomiting, diarrhea, new medicines, antibiotics and supplements can change the effect. Tell the anticoagulation team about changes and planned procedures. Do not stop or bridge treatment before dental work or surgery without a specific professional plan. Agree how benefit and adverse effects will be checked before changing treatment.

sections.heading: Everyday care
paragraphs: Keep vitamin K intake reasonably consistent rather than avoiding all green vegetables. Discuss alcohol and any major diet change. Follow the specific missed-dose instructions for your medicine; do not double a dose or improvise a correction. Choose a routine you can maintain, and discuss barriers such as cost, work or language.

sections.heading: Follow-up and warning signs
paragraphs: Head injury, uncontrolled bleeding, blood in vomit, black stools, severe headache or stroke symptoms need urgent assessment. A result outside the agreed limits also needs timely service advice even without symptoms. Suspected pregnancy requires prompt prescriber contact.

examples.text: In this hypothetical example, Mira starts an antibiotic and tells the monitoring service so it can decide whether an earlier INR is needed.

examples.title: Another practical example
